standingNegativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles
hook: That puddle under your car? The color tells you everything.
cta: Notice a puddle like that? Stop by and we'll take a look.

beats.label: hook
beats.vo: That puddle under your car? The color tells you everything.
beats.prompt: Extreme close-up of a small reddish-amber fluid puddle on dry gray asphalt in daylight, shallow depth of field, camera slowly pushes in, photorealistic, automotive documentary style, no people, no text.

beats.label: setup
beats.vo: Dark and oily — that's engine oil. Green or orange and slippery — coolant. But light amber, almost pinkish red, and thin? That one's easy to miss.
beats.prompt: Three small distinct fluid puddles on concrete garage floor side by side — one dark brown/black, one bright green, one light amber-pink — overhead shot, soft natural light, macro detail on liquid sheen, photorealistic, no people, no text.

beats.label: reveal
beats.vo: That's power steering fluid. It's thinner than oil, lighter in color, and it usually shows up near the front wheels or under the engine — right where the steering rack lives.
beats.prompt: Close-up under the hood of a car, steering rack and fluid reservoir area, a small drip of light amber fluid forming and falling, engine bay detail, photorealistic, documentary lighting, no people, no text.

beats.label: why-it-matters
beats.vo: Low fluid can mean heavier steering, a whine when you turn, or in some cars, losing power assist altogether. It's one clue — not a guess.
beats.prompt: Close-up of a power steering fluid reservoir cap being lifted, fluid level line visible against a translucent reservoir wall, engine bay background softly blurred, photorealistic, no people, no text.
beats.note: Swapped from a steering-wheel/hands shot to a reservoir-cap insert to stay clear of the standing negative prompt's hands exclusion.

beats.label: what-to-do
beats.vo: Don't top it off and hope. A leak means fluid's going somewhere — worth having it looked at before it gets worse.
beats.prompt: Close-up of a power steering fluid reservoir cap being lifted, fluid level line visible against a translucent reservoir wall, engine bay background softly blurred, photorealistic, no people, no text.

beats.prompt: Wide shot of a tidy automotive repair shop bay door, daylight, clean and professional, no signage text legible, no people, photorealistic.
